name: Kozagawa (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Kozagawa town emblem in white and orange: an outlined white lozenge enclosing an orange stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Kozagawa, a town in Wakayama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Kozagawa town emblem — an outlined white lozenge enclosing an orange stylised character
